resources.name: Mechanism and Catalytic Site Atlas
resources.redistribution_boundary: Derived identifiers and metadata may be redistributed with attribution and change notice; no raw API page is bundled in Phase A.
resources.row_link_policy: Direct M-CSA records are unreviewed candidate handles only; absence of a candidate handle is an explicit gap, not evidence that no entry exists.
limitations: An upstream curated entry is not independent review of this downstream crosswalk.
Entry granularity ranges from detailed mechanisms to active-site-only records.
Candidate handle overlap does not establish exact fingerprint equivalence.

resources.name: M-CSA arrow environments distributed with MechFind
resources.rights: MechFind non-profit/non-commercial license; underlying M-CSA attribution also applies
resources.redistribution_boundary: Reference-only in Phase A; no arrow-environment file or derived rule content is bundled.
resources.row_link_policy: Rows carry M-CSA lookup keys only; no arrow-environment match was computed.
limitations: The repository license is not a general permissive redistribution grant.
A shared M-CSA key is not an adjudicated arrow-environment equivalence.

resources.name: Rhea
resources.version: release not frozen in Phase A
resources.redistribution_boundary: Only query URIs and existing inherited snapshots are referenced; no new Rhea body is bundled.
resources.row_link_policy: EC-based query handles are lookup keys, never invented Rhea identifiers or asserted reaction matches.
limitations: Local DNS resolution failed for the official help pages during the bounded acquisition.
The FTP endpoint failed TLS negotiation in the local client.
No new direct Rhea record was assigned in Phase A.

resources.name: ChEBI
resources.version: live site observed 2026-07-14; monthly release not frozen
resources.redistribution_boundary: Only identifiers reported by the frozen M-CSA candidate response are carried; no ontology dump is bundled.
resources.row_link_policy: Candidate participant identifiers inherit M-CSA scope and remain unreviewed; protonation and microspecies applicability are unresolved.
limitations: Participant identity does not establish a balanced Rhea reaction.
Protonation and tautomer states can change mechanistic interpretation.

resources.name: EC-BLAST
resources.redistribution_boundary: Reference-only; no result table or bond-change object is bundled.
resources.row_link_policy: EC keys are recorded for a later bounded lookup; no bond-change match is asserted.
limitations: No stable batch API or release identifier was established.
No EC-BLAST search was run in Phase A.

resources.name: EnzymeMap
resources.redistribution_boundary: The 13.1 MiB atom-mapped reaction file was not acquired or bundled; metadata and EC lookup keys only.
resources.row_link_policy: An EC key indicates a possible future dataset lookup, not an atom-mapped reaction match.
limitations: BRENDA-derived reactions can be multiple and substrate-specific within one EC number.
No row-level EnzymeMap lookup or atom-map adjudication occurred.

resources.name: MechFind
resources.redistribution_boundary: Reference-only; no rules, predictions, or arrow environments are bundled.
resources.row_link_policy: M-CSA and EC keys are possible future lookup inputs; no prediction or equivalence is asserted.
limitations: Generated mechanisms would be hypotheses, not source truth.
No optimization, scoring, or reuse of published predictions occurred in Phase A.

resources.name: EzMechanism
resources.rights: M-CSA site content CC BY 4.0; generated-result terms not separately captured
resources.redistribution_boundary: Documentation link only; no account was requested and no result was generated or bundled.
resources.row_link_policy: Every row records the access gap explicitly; no outreach or registration attempt is claimed.
limitations: The service requires a registered M-CSA account.
Its inputs require structure, active-site, substrate, cofactor, reaction, and protonation choices that Phase A does not invent.

resources.name: EnzyMM
resources.rights: MIT software; M-CSA-derived template attribution applies
resources.redistribution_boundary: No software, templates, structures, or match tables are bundled.
resources.row_link_policy: M-CSA and UniProt handles are future lookup keys only; no structural template match is asserted.
limitations: Template matches are conformation-sensitive and do not predict EC numbers.
No structure scan was run in Phase A.

resources.name: ENZYME/EC nomenclature
resources.version: live per-EC pages; bulk release not frozen
resources.rights: bulk redistribution terms not recaptured in Phase A
resources.row_link_policy: EC numbers from M-CSA are source lookup keys and do not define a unique mechanism.
limitations: The guessed enzyme.dat endpoint returned HTTP 404.
EC classification is reaction-oriented and often broader or narrower than a mechanism family.

resources.name: InterPro
resources.version: release not frozen; release probe duplicated the license response
resources.rights: CC0 1.0 for InterPro, Pfam, PRINTS, and SFLD downloadable data
resources.redistribution_boundary: UniProt lookup links only; no InterPro match data is bundled.
resources.row_link_policy: Protein handles are lookup keys, not asserted domain assignments.
limitations: No row-level API lookup was run.
A family/domain match does not establish detailed mechanism applicability.

resources.name: Pfam through InterPro
resources.rights: CC0 1.0 for downloadable Pfam data on InterPro
resources.redistribution_boundary: Lookup links only; no Pfam assignments are bundled.
resources.row_link_policy: Protein handles are future lookup keys; no family-to-mechanism transfer is made.
limitations: No HMM or API search was run.
Family membership cannot independently review a mechanism mapping.

resources.name: CATH-Gene3D
resources.version: CATH-Plus 4.4; live latest links remain mutable
resources.redistribution_boundary: Only CATH identifiers returned by M-CSA are carried; no classification files are bundled.
resources.row_link_policy: Candidate fold handles remain unreviewed and do not license mechanism-field transfer.
limitations: Two selected candidates have explicit missing CATH handles.
A shared fold can support relationship queries but not copied chemistry.
